notes.title: Global update for Sea Walker Saga demo
notes.content:
[p]Attention, Tokyo! We're flying to the Tokyo Game Show and bringing the full Japanese localization with us! Get ready for total immersion: build your floating island, battle pirates, and set off on adventures in maximum comfort!
[/p][h2][b]What's new in the demo version?[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Redesigned inventory interface[/p][/*][*][p]Added mocap to cutscenes[/p][/*][*][p]Added artificial intelligence to pirates and islands[/p][/*][*][p]Improved graphics quality[/p][/*][*][p]Optimization work[/p][/*][*][p]Added Japanese localization[/p][/*][*][p]Added German localization[/p][/*][*][p]Added Turkish localization[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]But this is just the beginning! We look forward to meeting players from around the world who will appreciate the exciting Water World-inspired storyline and unique mechanics of Sea Walker Saga. Get ready for a great voyage![/b][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Sea Walker Saga: New Status of Sea Wanderers
notes.content:
[p]Sea Walker Saga is a stylized third-person RPG/RTS where you control an entire island and embark on a great sea voyage in search of the Mainland.[/p][p]Currently, 95% of the planned mechanics have been implemented, and we are ready to share what is already working.[/p][h2][b]What awaits you in Sea Walker Saga?[/b][/h2][p][b][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdJWv-1oztVWsekoJBHfFLtEOSi2i9WGS0fLdQ3T5EGMw4r0oPXB0iU20Jai67pjWdC_WU4rdgoeCS1-Lw38Dv99Q7abSK7ZY36SyT7qTh0n6JnZ5Y6pKvXq7FMpBNr_kQ-0hk4ng?key=PBO5WtjOaReGOqFzjghYGg"][/img][/b][/p][h3][b]Cutscenes[/b][/h3][p]From the very first minutes, you will be greeted by a cutscene that will introduce you to the plot and smoothly familiarize you with the controls and exploration of the world. Since this is a story-driven project, we believe it is very important to convey the story through staged scenes with characters and events on the screen.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Exploring the world[/b][/h3][p]Controlling the character from a third-person perspective, you will be able to examine objects in the environment, collect notes, interact with characters, and immerse yourself in the story — all without having to read miles of text. The game is fully voiced by professional actors in Russian and English.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf6yPp33M9408Ut3Pu_UtaMnPrbuEPDpweS2A6V3wQC0TMSOlZlyRz4tGJNXd7QbqyOjB_oR7gE1PqqsG2owSxYzXrDAEfWNOFTXpLPL-5c7XqYswZlc_fJbTQL0ELXTB3HusG7gg?key=PBO5WtjOaReGOqFzjghYGg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Your island[/b][/h3][p]Isla Movimi is not just an island where you can build and study blueprints, but a fully-fledged vehicle. We have implemented thrust control, engine lock, and engine rotation — this giant is a pleasure to work with, and it feels large-scale and majestic. The first association that comes to mind when controlling it is the Millennium Falcon from Star Wars, and the comparison, I must say, is not accidental.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Studying blueprints and leveling up[/b][/h3][p]One of the mechanics is a mini-game dedicated to studying building blueprints. It is a puzzle: you need to connect all the dots on the screen without crossing the line. The mechanic is relaxing and engaging at the same time — a great way to change the pace before getting down to construction. What's more, studying blueprints will allow you to improve the level of buildings on your island.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXenGwwimaDErOLPZdOkarCRKGB9SmsI0zcYqa88LNNrYgTIVoD768JRG8h6go4YFwRUkhhysvUJMhR-IrpiiWBFjCuv7f05UbbEcrMTt67UB5cQtqJeslRzvj5Ik7xn9sGb_4NjrA?key=PBO5WtjOaReGOqFzjghYGg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Drone and bathyscaphe control[/b][/h3][p]Yes, we have a full-fledged flight simulator and an underwater world simulator. Take control of the equipment manufactured on the island and go into battle![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXczu0Kkr-Lz1R2MtpzWgqgH9CHhHHGXxIl1TeF1GkriIieQonZapohNTbmq-W0ZY2UwWUKxBIPXZbVm6HYmPeZ-G6hfoZW-o_2fZhTvamvDQxFwt3NZXi8AKMoB-dZbCgXIlZUW?key=PBO5WtjOaReGOqFzjghYGg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Construction[/b][/h3][p]Buildings can be constructed in designated areas on the island — a lighthouse, an engine, an assembly station, turrets, and even a hangar for a drone that will be used to attack other floating islands. And that's not all that has already been implemented.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfE5htARE1tkPVtrNN6AcftweK3eqhqTC9kI8hgn37s0QSHx10JKb33voEokWmoexe40Wdthl5KvTsJdxxcyZPr2lsRiFCiW42MCeoNDve2Pfoa3oQSdxSWuTFtg-qT5fvOXQTZ?key=PBO5WtjOaReGOqFzjghYGg"][/img][/p][h3][b]The main building — the lighthouse[/b][/h3][p]It is not only a landmark, but also a control center: collected notes, plants, paintings, and collectibles are stored here. In the future, we plan to develop gardening mechanics — you will be able to care for the plants you find, watch them grow and change. And the most important thing inside the lighthouse is the map. It is with its help that you will be able to embark on a journey.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXc1gzkjtiDDHM_5MPzc74rdCL5TKKCRbxf0le8cpkC3plEKszM0Xqizzekr2ZAjmcL44Ot8UAnf4aZlTm3PRsg83fPLDzK2Tl0N-dzGQ5BpcXKLnqjwUDhcj7sRsWzrFapn-2eq8g?key=PBO5WtjOaReGOqFzjghYGg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Exploring the world is not limited to the surface[/b][/h3][p]Your character can don a deep-sea diving suit inspired by the inventions of Cousteau and Gagnan and dive to the bottom of the sea. There you will find collectible items, elements, and underwater landscapes. And if you want to go deeper, build an underwater shipyard, assemble a bathyscaphe, and participate in underwater races. We'll leave the details behind the scenes for now — it's better to explore this mechanic for yourself. The bathyscaphe will also come in handy in battle: you can use it to defend yourself or attack.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeAno1-2CjqtVHCjM3CyOM40gNZeGOi_asYnFMT1qpxYzjKOnGI_v4DC7jRIMx_yF7YKodq31TnKxGiAcsj_Lee5HLti9vhaw5usoSkp9dpoAIMFPUTEzsJsDL884BW_MaI87Q2Mg?key=PBO5WtjOaReGOqFzjghYGg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Firefights[/b][/h3][p]You will also face missions involving landings on islands, where you will encounter dynamic combat inspired by Mass Effect, complete with dodging and cover. We wanted to make combat not just an additional option, but a full-fledged part of the game — and we hope we have succeeded.[/p][p]The demo version is available today. Download it, try it out, and share your impressions. It doesn't include all the elements of the final version yet, but you can already get a feel for the overall concept. We plan to release early access later this year, where you'll find a full-fledged campaign lasting 4+ hours with 6 changing locations. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXecDh2-6zadrffH0j-atCtqYAzQD5I8-9-kSo58AD6oB4vCTZgVf8IyLFG5w5ETLinNmmxRM_KqOuZ-8w2QP8UIJODNRFWKeeRJHImK7t5pnDc3OUwSGMr0Tw94Ip-gRGMT6JVB?key=PBO5WtjOaReGOqFzjghYGg"][/img][/p][p][b]Add the game to your wishlist and be sure to send us your feedback [/b]— it helps us move forward and makes the project even better and more interesting.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Sea Walker Saga demo update
notes.content:
Friends, listening to your feedback, we decided to finalize the demo version! You may have already noticed new colorful covers from our artist, but the project has been transformed not only visually

[b]The following fixes are already available:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an old critical bug on Archipelago related to the controller and interaction
[*] Added a new tutorial system
[*] Removed unnecessary details from scenes
[*] Fixed environment lodes
[*] Added loading icon on the loading screen
[*] Minor fixes with character getting stuck between islands on Archipelago
[*] Added new textures to islands
[*] Updated borders with colliders on Marco Island
[*] Improved vegetation shaders: notice by grass and FPS
[*] Redesigned materials on all characters: now there is no pronounced blue edge on clothes and skin
[*] Changed final cutscene
[*] Added a couple of new auxiliary hints
[*] Other small edits to make the game more comfortable
[/list]
[b]Enjoy your journey across the vast seas in search of the mythical continent![/b]

notes.title: Sea Walker Saga: genre, setting, idea
notes.content:
Probably most of you from the title have already decided that it will be about sea battles on ships. But no.

[h2]The setting[/h2]
Steampunk - 1878.

A worldwide flood has swallowed everything. The world turned into an endless ocean. To survive, people had to learn to create their own islands, and to trade and communicate, they had to animate them.

With the help of special machines and engines, the islands learned to swim. The main character will get his own island for adventure. Together with him you will have to revive the island and go on it on an endless journey across the boundless seas in search of the mythical continent. Sea and air battles, exploring underwater depths and searching for allies for survival will accompany you throughout the journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45232928/17c851f0e357a8107aa0d5a888a1757c2ddc3751.jpg[/img]

[h2]Genre[/h2]
RTS and 3rd-person simulation with RPG elements.

[h2]How was the idea born?[/h2]
Back in the 2000's there was one amazing game called Project Nomads. It had no story at all. The head of our studio played it for the sake of gameplay variety. He replayed it several times.

While playing that game, he had ideas on how to make a much more interesting and large-scale project. And also to add a terrific story. It was then, in 2004, that the first rudiments of Sea Walker were born.
And as Sherlock says, the ideas were folded into the Mind's Heights. 

Today, our team pulls all the ideas out of the wormhole and puts them into game design, script and a unique universe.

[b]We're confident that Sea Walker Saga will be truly addictive. And not only with gameplay, but also with an engaging story![/b]
